summary: Naomi says my daughter shall I not seek rest that it may be well with you? Isn't Boaz of our family, with whose young women you were, behold he winnows barley tonight at threshing floor, wash anoint put on best clothes go down but don't make self known until he has done eating drinking, mark place where he lies go uncover his feet and lie down and he will tell you what to do. Ruth says all you say I will do, goes down at night, Boaz lies down at end of heap of grain, she comes softly uncovers feet and lies down, at midnight man startled sees woman at feet, who are you? I am Ruth your handmaid spread therefore your skirt over handmaid for you are near kinsman, Boaz says blessed be you of Yahweh daughter you have showed more kindness at latter end than beginning not going after young men poor or rich, now don't fear all I will do for you, for all city knows you are worthy woman, but there is kinsman nearer than I, remain this night in morning if he will redeem good, if not then I will redeem as Yahweh lives, lie down until morning, she lay at his feet until morning rose before one could recognize another, Boaz says let it not be known woman came to threshing floor, gives six measures barley, goes to city Naomi asks who are you, tells, Naomi says sit still my daughter until you know how matter will fall for man will not rest until he finishes today.
whyItMatters: Risky step — Ruth at threshing floor at midnight asks Boaz to spread skirt/wing over her — marriage proposal using his earlier prayer (under wings you came to take refuge). Shows bold loyalty and Boaz's integrity.

keyVerses.text: He said, “Who are you?” She answered, “I am Ruth your servant. Therefore spread the corner of your garment over your servant; for you are a near kinsman.”
keyVerses.why: Proposal — spread skirt/wing over — marriage plea using Boaz's own prayer language.

keyVerses.text: Now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do to you all that you say; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman.
keyVerses.why: Worthy woman — eshet chayil, same as Proverbs 31.

keyVerses.text: Then she said, “Wait, my daughter, until you know what will happen; for the man will not rest until he has settled this today.”
keyVerses.why: Naomi confident Boaz will act today.

questions.question: What does uncover his feet and lie down and spread skirt over me mean? Is this sexual?
questions.answer: Uncover feet — margelot — feet can be euphemism for genitals in some texts, but here likely literal feet at end of grain pile where Boaz lies to guard harvest. Lying at feet is posture of servant requesting protection, not seduction, though risk of misinterpretation. Spread your skirt/wing/edge of garment over handmaid — same word kanaph as wings in 2:12 under whose wings you came to take refuge — and also means edge of garment, wing. Ruth asks Boaz to embody his own prayer: be the wings. And to redeem as kinsman — marriage proposal, not just cover. Boaz treats honorably: calls daughter, blesses, does not act sexually, protects reputation by having her leave before recognizable.

questions.question: Why does Naomi tell Ruth to wash anoint put best clothes go down? Is she using Ruth?
questions.answer: Naomi seeks rest (menuha — security, home, marriage) for Ruth that it may be well. Wash anoint best clothes — preparation not for seduction but for presenting as worthy woman at important moment, like Esther preparing. Threshing floor night after winnowing is celebration, owners sleep near grain to guard. Plan is bold and risky by modern standards, but within cultural customs of kinsman-redeemer request at threshing floor — place of provision. Naomi's instruction he will tell you what to do shows trust in Boaz's integrity.

questions.question: What does 'nearer kinsman' and 'I will redeem' mean?
questions.answer: There is kinsman nearer than Boaz who has first right to redeem land and marry widow to raise name of dead. Boaz says remain night, in morning if he will redeem good, if not I will redeem as Yahweh lives — oath. Shows Boaz will follow law even though he wants to redeem, respecting order. Next chapter gate scene resolves. Ruth's action is more kindness at latter end than beginning — first kindness leaving Moab for Naomi, second not going after young men poor or rich but seeking older Boaz for loyalty to family, not romance alone.

glossary.def: Edge of garment, wing — protection, covering, marriage — Ruth asks Boaz be wings she sought refuge under.
Woman of valor — same as Proverbs 31, capable, strong, recognized by city.
Redeemer with right to buy land and marry widow to preserve name.
